Where in Shopify admin: Products > open the product > Search engine listing > Edit (pencil icon) > Page title
What to write or set: What it is, one key detail, then your brand. Use the words buyers type.
Limit or rule: About 60 characters or less. If blank, Shopify uses the product title.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Speckled Stoneware Mug, 350 ml, Sage Green | Fernmoor

Where in Shopify admin: Search engine listing > Edit > Meta description
What to write or set: What it is, 2 or 3 facts buyers check, one reason to click. Write it like a short ad, but only true facts.
Limit or rule: About 155 characters or less. Each product gets its own.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Handmade speckled stoneware mug in sage green. Holds 350 ml, dishwasher and microwave safe. Ships in a gift box in 3 to 5 working days.

Where in Shopify admin: Search engine listing > Edit > URL handle
What to write or set: The product name in short: lowercase, dashes, no filler words like the, best, new.
Limit or rule: Short and stable. If you change it, keep Create a URL redirect ticked.

Where in Shopify admin: On your computer, before you upload
What to write or set: Rename the photo to say what it is. Shopify keeps the name in the image link.

Where in Shopify admin: Media > click the photo > Alt text
What to write or set: Say what is in the photo in plain words: product, colour, material, setting.
Limit or rule: About 125 characters or less. No keyword lists. Do not start with Image of.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Fernmoor speckled stoneware mug in sage green on a wooden table

Field: Alt text for every other photo
Where in Shopify admin: Media > click each photo > Alt text
What to write or set: Say what is different in this photo: the detail, the size, the use.
Limit or rule: About 125 characters or less. Each photo gets its own text.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Close-up of the speckled glaze and curved handle of the sage green mug

What to write or set: Type the product word and pick the most exact match from Shopify's list.
Limit or rule: Pick from the list. It decides which extra fields (category metafields) you can fill.

Where in Shopify admin: Product page > fields shown under Category
What to write or set: Fill every field Shopify shows that fits, for example colour and material. Use the same value spelling on every product.
Limit or rule: Only true values. These feed filters and some sales channels.

What to write or set: Your own word for what it is.
Limit or rule: One word or short phrase, same spelling on every similar product.

What to write or set: Your brand name, or the maker's brand if you resell.
Add the product to every shelf it belongs on.
Limit or rule: Usually 1 to 3. No empty or joke collections.

What to write or set: Words for your own sorting, smart collections and filters.
Limit or rule: About 3 to 8. Lowercase, one spelling each. Not a keyword list for Google.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): stoneware, handmade, gift idea, dishwasher safe

What to write or set: Real numbers buyers ask about: size, capacity, material, care, delivery time.
Limit or rule: Numbers, not words like large or fast. See section 7 for the full structure.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): 350 ml, 9.5 cm tall, stoneware, dishwasher and microwave safe, ships in 3 to 5 working days

Where in Shopify admin: End of the description, or a Collapsible content section in the product template
What to write or set: 3 to 6 real buyer questions. Answer in the first sentence.
Limit or rule: Only true answers. See section 5 for the HTML and JSON-LD.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Can the Fernmoor Speckled Mug go in the dishwasher? Yes, and in the microwave too.

What to write or set: The real barcode number from the packaging, if the product has one.
Limit or rule: Never make one up. Handmade items often have none.

Where in Shopify admin: Search engine listing preview + live page on a phone
What to write or set: Read the preview. Title and description are not cut off in a bad place. Photos load and the alt text matches each photo.
Demo example (Fernmoor, made-up brand): Title and description read well, all photos have alt text
